import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset into a pandas DataFrame
data = {
    'StichtagDat': ['2024-12-31', '2025-12-31', '2019-12-31', '2020-12-31', '2021-12-31'],
    'StichtagDatJahr': [2024, 2025, 2019, 2020, 2021],
    'AlterV10Lang': ['30- bis 39-Jährige'] * 5,
    'KreisLang': ['Kreis 7', 'Kreis 7', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10'],
    'Rasse1Text': ['Deutsche Dogge', 'Deutsche Dogge', 'Continental Bulldog', 'Continental Bulldog', 'Continental Bulldog'],
    'AnzHunde': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert 'StichtagDat' to datetime
df['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(df['StichtagDat'])

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
ax = sns.countplot(data=df, x='KreisLang', hue='Rasse1Text', palette='viridis')

# Set title and labels
ax.set_title('Number of Dogs by Region and Breed')
ax.set_xlabel('Region (Kreis)')
ax.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')

# Adjust legend
plt.legend(title='Breed', loc='upper right')

# Save the plot as a PNG file
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
